name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
summary: Switches between two to five views or modes: an inset track with the picked segment raised.
use: To switch the view of the same content: a period, a layout, a platform.

options.name: label
options.description: Required. Names the control for assistive technology.

options.name: iconOnly
options.description: Icons alone, with labels as tooltips and accessible names: for tab bars of familiar icons.

options.name: indicator
options.description: leds puts a dot under each position, lit under the picked one, as on a hardware selector.

rules: One or two words per segment.
The picked segment is a raised cap, never ink or the accent.
